Navigation

Fixo de rumo/distância

A specified position defined by the intersection of a bearing from a navigation aid and a measured distance, used for fixes, approaches, and reporting points.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Fixo de rumo/distância?

In this glossary, Fixo de rumo/distância refers to: A specified position defined by the intersection of a bearing from a navigation aid and a measured distance, used for fixes, approaches, and reporting points.

How is Fixo de rumo/distância used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Prossiga para o fixo de rumo 090 e distância 12 milhas do VOR MIK e aguarde conforme publicado."

Why does Fixo de rumo/distância matter in aviation?

Fixo de rumo/distância matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Fixo de rumo/distância is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Definition

A specified position defined by the intersection of a bearing from a navigation aid and a measured distance, used for fixes, approaches, and reporting points.

Operational example

Proceed to the bearing 090 and distance 12 miles fix from VOR MIK and hold as published.

Localized term

Fixo de rumo/distância

Localized example
